denominatorDefinitions.metadataCommandSchemaSites: Distinct command object source spans reachable from the bound exported metadata registry initializer, including finite-map callback schema spans; metadata is not a handler registration.
denominatorDefinitions.metadataCommandInstances: Statically resolved metadata instances: fixed ID schemas plus finite literal array/map/template expansions, preserving shared source spans; not runtime registrations.
denominatorDefinitions.nativeMenuApiCalls: AST native Menu API and MenuItem expressions with electron require binding in complete frozen main; a call may construct/install/mutate a menu and is not a runtime item count.
denominatorDefinitions.nativeItemSchemaConstructionSites: Distinct literal interactive/container item schema object expressions with click, role or submenu properties in bound native menu construction scopes and schema-producing helpers; generated map instances and platform/feature filters are not expanded.
denominatorDefinitions.nativeTemplateGeneratorOptionSites: Distinct object inputs passed to bound template-generating local helpers, separate from their output schema objects.
denominatorDefinitions.osGlobalHigherWrapperConsumerCalls: Calls to lexical wrappers which themselves call the one native globalShortcut.register wrapper; runtime loops/keymap values remain dynamic.
denominatorDefinitions.beforeInputEventRegistrations: Complete main AST .on(before-input-event, handler) calls, not unique shortcuts or all renderer key handlers.

limitations: Renderer review supplements preserve their complete-program fragment proof versus original full-source binding unknowns; selected hook registrations are a separate partial denominator.
No target code was executed and no UI/account/history/model was accessed.
Conditional source branches are recorded; feature values, entitlement, platform-specific runtime registration and final item counts remain unknown.
Schemas sharing command IDs are linked only through the bound metadata producer/registry, not by unrelated string matches.
Some native context menus accept dynamic renderer/native payloads and their item instances cannot be enumerated statically.
Bound callbacks are traced at most five local-call edges; injected receivers, dynamically installed/inherited methods, Promise continuations and external modules remain explicit unknowns.
Metadata includes multiple command kinds and products; neither chat names nor requiredAccess values justify deleting functionality.
Separator-only schemas are present in registration arguments and dataflow evidence but are excluded from the interactive/container schema denominator.

All native API call expressions with an electron namespace binding in main are inventoried, but schema helper traversal is a bounded source denominator, not proof of complete application feature coverage.
stableIdBasis: contractId: contract kind plus first 24 hex SHA256 of baselineId, kind, original sourcePath/sourceHash, complete primary byte span and explicit finite-map instance ID. Stable within this frozen baseline and parser/review inputs; not a cross-version feature ID.
evidenceReferenceConvention: Every ...EvidenceId and ...EvidenceIds value resolves to menu-command-evidence.jsonl.id; nested argument/binding/dataflow/condition/callback/calleeTrace/review evidence is retained. contractRecordIndex gives primaryEvidenceKey and JSON pointer for each stamped record.
